notes: «5051» is a number and «عليه السلام» a blessing: left out
«عبيد بن زرارة أو بريد العجلي» are alternatives at one level (rule 2); «الشك من محمد» is the compiler's note on that doubt and is not a link
«قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» names the Imam the questioner addresses: the Imam is the last link (rule 5, owner ruling 2); the questioner «قلت» is the alternative transmitter at level 5
